module: Flowgraph node "Complete Quest" (category once_instant, career color/icon). Completes the quest associated with the flowgraph via career_modules_questManager.completeQuest(mgr.quest.id), only if career is active and the graph has a quest (self.mgr.quest). Input pin: completeOnStop (bool, default true, hardCoded).
notes: The completeOnStop pin is declared ("completes only when the manager stops, with a one-frame delay") but is not read in this file: the quest is completed immediately.
The pin uses the key "hardCoded" (capital C) whereas the other nodes write "hardcoded".

workOnce.desc: Calls completeQuest for the graph's quest if career is active.
